summary: Fees range widened 40-86 -> 40-138: cheapest motorhome site $40 on both a May and a June 2027 weeknight; the dearest type (Pull Thru KOA Patio) is $86 in May, $138 in June. Confirmed full hookups and pull-throughs; added 50 A, 80-ft max length, WiFi/camp store, the April 1 - November 1 season, the koa.com reserve url. Stored lakeview is consistent with a guest review ('Gorgeous lake and fountain views ... the KOA patio overlooking the water'); unchanged. Note cleaned (dropped the rate and RV Life line).
flags: Gate facts (private): cheapest motorhome site $40 before tax on Tue 2027-05-18 and Tue 2027-06-15 (30-amp water/electric back-in). Not a Good Sam Park (directory gs false). gateways.py: none within 40 km (Cincinnati 85 km). Presence: koa.com page + booking form. Google Maps: Dayton KOA Holiday 4.4 from 1,154 reviews, (937) 833-3888. Gate by season: cheapest $40 in both shoulder (May) and summer (June); the full-hookup types run $61-86 in May and $66-138 in June, but the gate passes either way. Long-stay (test 4, all nightly sites): KOA publishes no site counts; all nine RV site types and the tent sites are sold by the night, and 'Extended Stays' is offered as one more way to stay - no sign that nightly sites are under 1 in 10. Passes.
